implementation_constraints: Do not overwrite an existing summon_op_id.
Do not change MID50 result shape expected by SelfPlayer:summonHero().
Do not infer Summon rates/pools/pity from client-local RNG helpers.
Keep Campaign/MID117 and MID70/MID305 outside this bounded migration.
verified_facts: SUMMON_HERO is MID50; MID305 Super Summon and MID70 Magic remain separate protocol planes.
SelfPlayer:summonHero() is the single direct MID50 network choke point in effective src_64.
xyd.generateUUID() emits lowercase UUIDv4-shaped text and is identity entropy, not gameplay outcome entropy.
Backend.lua pendingRequests stores params = original request params and retry passes iter_30_1.params back to webRequest_.
Therefore an ID injected once into the params table before the initial MID50 request survives transport retries.
